landing.lead: Raise local issues with your neighbours. The ones that matter rise to your constituency, county and the nation — transparently, never for sale.

landing.point.elevation: See why posts rise — every score is explained
join.title: Join the Civic Platform
join.consent.name: Consent
join.consent.heading: Before you begin
join.consent.intro: To make sure every member is a real resident of their ward, we ask for your national ID number and phone number.
join.consent.purpose: Purpose: your ID is used only to confirm you are a real person and to place you in your ward. Never for advertising.
join.consent.storage: Storage: we keep only a secure one-way code of your ID, never the number itself. Your phone number is encrypted.
join.consent.access: Access: only you and, when the law requires, our Data Protection Officer.
join.consent.rights: Your rights: you can see, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time.
join.consent.checkbox: I agree to the processing of my national ID and phone number for these purposes.
join.consent.required: Please tick the box to agree before continuing.
join.consent.kslUnavailable: The sign-language video for this notice is being produced and will appear here.
join.identity.name: Your ID and phone
join.identity.idHint: 8 digits. It is never shown to anyone.
join.identity.phoneHint: We'll send a code to this number. Example: 0712 345 678
join.identity.phoneError: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, for example 0712 345 678.
join.ward.name: Your ward
join.ward.heading: Where do you live?
join.ward.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters, e.g. Kiamwangi
join.ward.noResults: No match. Try another spelling, or choose below.
join.profile.name: Your profile
join.profile.displayNameHint: Shown on your posts. You can use a nickname.
join.verify.name: Verify your phone
join.verify.heading: Enter the code we sent
join.verify.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}.
join.verify.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the SMS or request a new code.
join.verify.resendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} s
join.verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
join.error.alreadyRegistered: This national ID is already registered.
join.done.title: Welcome, {name}!

why.elevated: This post was elevated from {from} to {to} because its relevance score exceeded that level's threshold. Scores come from likes, replies, how many different people took part, and age — never from payment.
why.ward: This post is from your ward. Posts start here and rise only when neighbours find them useful.
